scope: Follow-up coverage for LAFAN40 / G1 29DoF, limited to the three checkpoint releases below.
selection: Only these three releases remain under inspection. Projects without a public checkpoint or with only single-motion checkpoints are no longer being followed.

entries.name: Humanoid-GPT Transformer 216
entries.status: Temporal inference checked; full evaluation pending
entries.gap: The original 42,977,083-byte ONNX requires 16 × 136 observations; the author script default is 4 frames. A 16-frame adapter passed 160 matched-input comparisons and 4 resets. No complete-suite result is published for this checkpoint.
entries.next_step: Complete full 40-motion evaluation, trajectory verification and repeatability as a separate checkpoint version.

entries.name: ScaleBFM
entries.gap: Official Hugging Face release contains M and XL PyTorch checkpoints. The M checkpoint (72,856,655 bytes) was SHA256-verified and loaded strictly with the author CPU network. Observation/history, control-mode and motor-target parity are still pending; the older shared ONNX is not used.
entries.next_step: Finish author ScaleBridge end-to-end comparison, then full 40-motion evaluation and repeatability.

entries.name: HoloMotion v1.3.1
entries.gap: The original ONNX fails at index 8192. Current author runtime explicitly supports a legacy max-length override and resets the KV cache at max length minus 64. Boundary probes with length 8192 pass; new-runtime observation parity and a complete long rollout remain unverified.
entries.next_step: Verify the author legacy path with v1.3.1 observations, then full 40-motion evaluation and repeatability.
